excerpt.zh: [Planet.GetName]上发现了一个硕大无朋的金属立方体。它的外表天衣无缝暗示了先进的技术能力，但我们还无从推测它的起源或功能。考古发掘也许能提供答案。
excerpt.en: A colossal metallic cube has been found on [Planet.GetName]. Its seamless form is suggestive of advanced technological capabilities, although we cannot begin to speculate upon its origin or function. An archaeological expedition may provide answers.

texts.zh: [Planet.GetName]上发现了一个硕大无朋的金属立方体。它的外表天衣无缝暗示了先进的技术能力，但我们还无从推测它的起源或功能。考古发掘也许能提供答案。
texts.en: A colossal metallic cube has been found on [Planet.GetName]. Its seamless form is suggestive of advanced technological capabilities, although we cannot begin to speculate upon its origin or function. An archaeological expedition may provide answers.

sections.zh: [Planet.GetName]上发现了一个硕大无朋的金属立方体。它的外表天衣无缝暗示了先进的技术能力，但我们还无从推测它的起源或功能。考古发掘也许能提供答案。
sections.en: A colossal metallic cube has been found on [Planet.GetName]. Its seamless form is suggestive of advanced technological capabilities, although we cannot begin to speculate upon its origin or function. An archaeological expedition may provide answers.

texts.zh: 对在[fromfrom.planet.GetName]上的巨大神秘方块进行进一步调查反而带来了比答案更多的问题。它的外表面绝对光滑无缝，我们的扫描仪无法穿透。当我们靠近立方体时，它光洁壮观的立面突然轻轻泛起涟漪，响应着我们的出现。[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]得出结论，它是由某种形式的活体金属建造而成的。
texts.en: Closer inspection of the giant mysterious cube on [fromfrom.planet.GetName] has raised more questions than answers. Its outer surfaces are perfectly smooth, seamless, and impenetrable to our scanners. As we approached the cube, the imposing facade seemed to ripple gently in response to our presence. [event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName] has concluded that it is constructed of a form of Living Metal.

texts.zh: 对在[fromfrom.planet.GetName]上的巨大神秘方块进行进一步调查反而带来了比答案更多的问题。它的外表面绝对光滑无缝，我们的扫描仪无法穿透。当我们靠近立方体时，它光洁壮观的立面突然轻轻泛起涟漪，响应着我们的出现。[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]得出结论，它是由前所未见的某种形式的怪异金属建造而成的。
texts.en: Closer inspection of the giant mysterious cube on [fromfrom.planet.GetName] has raised more questions than answers. Its outer surfaces are perfectly smooth, seamless, and impenetrable to our scanners. As we approached the cube, the imposing facade seemed to ripple gently in response to our presence. [event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName] has concluded that it is constructed of a form of strange metal unlike any we have previously seen.

texts.zh:
[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]在检查[fromfrom.planet.GetName]上的金属立方体时，其中一个表面突然泛起涟漪并且形成了一个通向该物体内部的开口。刚一进入，我们就发现了一个仍被腐坏的软体动物尸体占据着的控制台；不管它的肉体曾经如何，现在都化成了一抔黄土。

我们在控制台上发现了一个不寻常的容器，里面不时嘭哐作响似乎是有什么东西在里面活动。然而，这个容器的密封非常复杂，[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]目前还无法将其打开。
texts.en:
While [event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName] was examining the metallic cube on [fromfrom.planet.GetName], one of its surfaces unexpectedly rippled and parted to create an opening into the object's interior. Upon entering, we found a command console still occupied by the husk of a decayed molluscoid; whatever flesh it may have once held has now decomposed into a pale dust.

On the console, we found an unusual container from which occasional thuds and dull clangs can be heard as if something is moving inside. However, the container's seal is complex and [event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName] has thus far been unable to open it.

label.zh: 我们肯定还能回收这些粉尘。
label.en: Surely we can still recover the dust.

texts.zh:
在对立方体中控台进行数据挖掘的过程中，[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]恢复并解码了两小段音频日志，里面是由同一位发言人发出的一连串咽喉喌音和刺耳的声门塞音。在语言学数据库中交叉检索后，[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]发现了一种与之相匹配的古代语言，并得出了第一份音频日志的能够理解的翻译：

“主席团成员们，请听我一言。要避免这场战争还有时间。你们君主的自信极不明智，我们难道可以打败[Owner.GetAnomalousCubeEnemy]吗，这样下去最终的结局只有毁灭！”

“安抚他们才是我们唯一的选项。这个匣子里装有一件礼物，可以作为和平的象征：这就是我们活体金属的精巧技艺。要想逃过这次劫难，只能将这件礼物送给他们。”
texts.en:
While data mining the cube's central console, [event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName] was able to recover and decrypt two short audio logs. They contain a series of guttural clicks and harsh glottal stops vocalized by a single speaker. By cross-referencing our linguistic database, [event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName] found a comparable ancient language and has produced a working translation of the first audio log:

'My presidium, you must hear me. There is still time to avoid this war. Your dynasts' confidence is injudicious, we cannot defeat [Owner.GetAnomalousCubeEnemy]. They will destroy us!'

'Appeasement is our only option. My crate contains a gift, a likely token of peace: the secrets of our living metal mastery. The only way to avoid oblivion is to deliver it to them.'

texts.zh:
第二段来自立方体控制台的音频信息也翻译完成了。

“主席团成员们，我失败了。我们的覆灭已经在劫难逃了。

我的六面体太空船遭到破坏，将会尝试紧急着陆在[fromfrom.planet.GetName]上。即便我侥幸存活，这件和平信物也无法送达了。[Owner.GetAnomalousCubeEnemy]将如我们所恐惧的一般攻打我们。”

[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]已经完成匣子闭锁机构的破解。匣子里是一团异乎寻常的金属。它极具延展性和超响应性，不断地每过几秒就重塑成新的复杂外形。
texts.en:
The second audio log from the cube's command console has been translated.

'My presidium, I have failed. Our annihilation is imminent and inexorable.

My hexahedral spacecraft was sabotaged. I will attempt an emergency landing on [fromfrom.planet.GetName]. Even if I survive, the peace token will not be delivered, and [Owner.GetAnomalousCubeEnemy] will attack as we feared.'

[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName] has successfully decoded the locking mechanism on the crate. Contained within is a peculiar nugget of metal. It is particularly malleable and hyperactive, endlessly reshaping itself into intricate new forms every few seconds.

texts.zh: 我们可以自己留着这个怪东西来加深我们对活体金属的理解，或是接替它的原主完成原定的事务；将其作为礼物送给[Owner.GetAnomalousCubeEnemy]以改进我们与之的关系。
texts.en: We could retain this curiosity to further our understanding of living metal or we could do as its previous owners had intended; offer it as a gift to [Owner.GetAnomalousCubeEnemy] in order to improve our standing with them.

texts.zh: 这件独特的物品和立方体舰船的来历可以加深我们对活体金属的理解。
texts.en: This remarkable item and the cuboid vessel it came from will be used to further our knowledge of living metal.

texts.zh: 我们可以自己留着这个怪东西来加深我们对这种出色金属的理解，或是接替它的原主完成原定的事务；将其作为礼物送给[Owner.GetAnomalousCubeEnemy]以改进我们与之的关系。
texts.en: We could retain this curiosity to further our understanding of this remarkable metal or we could do as its previous owners had intended; offer it as a gift to [Owner.GetAnomalousCubeEnemy] in order to improve our standing with them.

texts.zh: 这件独特的物品和立方体舰船的来历可以加深我们对金属化合物和结构的理解。
texts.en: This remarkable item and the cuboid vessel it came from will be used to further our knowledge of metallic compounds and structures.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]恒星系内发现了一种此前未知的战略资源，称为稀有水晶。它们在聚焦极光束方面十分有效，同时也是许多先进电子用品的必备材料。
texts.en: The [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed Rare Crystals in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system. They have properties that help focus laser beams, and are also a critical component in most advanced electronics.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]恒星系内发现了一种此前未知的战略资源，称为异星天然气。这些气体具有多种潜在用途，包括用于先进能量武器、立场护盾、飞船染料甚至作为消遣性药品使用。
texts.en: The [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed Exotic Gases in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system. They have various potential applications, including advanced energy-based weaponry, force fields, starship fuel, and even recreational drugs.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]恒星系内发现了一种此前未知的战略资源，称为易爆微粒。这些微粒中蕴含着大量的能量，作为能源、燃料甚至炸药都十分出色。
texts.en: The [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed Volatile Motes in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system. They contain immense energy, with applications ranging from energy production and fuel to explosives.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]恒星系发现了一种前所未知的战略资源，称为泽珞。这是一种来源不明的气溶胶，[Root.Owner.GetIngestedLoc]后可以让拥有天赋的[Root.Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]提升灵能力。$action.92.part3$
texts.en: The [Root.GetName] has discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed Zro in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system. It is a rare aerosol of unknown origin, and when [Root.Owner.GetIngestedLoc], it enhances the abilities of psionically-gifted [Root.Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural].$action.92.part3$

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]恒星系发现了一种前所未知的战略资源，称为暗物质。它似乎打破了一些物理法则，具有引发科学革命的潜力。
texts.en: The [Root.GetName] has discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed Dark Matter in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system. It seemingly defying several natural laws, and could potentially revolutionize the sciences.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]恒星系发现了一种前所未知的战略资源，称为活体金属。其具有通常只能在有机生物形式上才能见到的特性，会自动恢复成被稳定塑造好的形态。
texts.en: The [Root.GetName] has discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed Living Metal in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system. It has characteristics usually seen only in biological life forms, and will always attempt to regenerate back into the shape it was stabilized into.

texts.zh: 在对[From.GetStarName]进行调查时，[Root.GetName]发现了一种新的战略资源，称为星界丝缕。它在扭曲时空方面的独特性质可以用在若干有趣的用途。
texts.en: During its survey of [From.GetStarName], the [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed Astral Threads. Its unique properties in distorting time and space could be put to use in a number of interesting ways.

texts.zh:
我们拥有相应的科技——要是能够控制该恒星系，就能攫取这份资源。

在探索星系的过程中我们肯定定能找到更多这样的资源，带来独特的性质和用途。
texts.en:
We have the technology - if we control this system, we can extract this resource.

We are sure to find more of these types of resources as we continue to explore the galaxy, each with unique properties and applications.

texts.zh:
虽说我们尚不能提取这种资源，但应该考虑在该星系建立控制，以便日后开发。

在探索星系的过程中我们肯定定能找到更多这样的资源，带来独特的性质和用途。
texts.en:
We cannot extract this resource yet, but we could establish control over the system for future exploitation.

We are sure to find more of these types of resources as we continue to explore the galaxy, each with unique properties and applications.

tooltips.zh:
£rare_crystals£稀有水晶
这些水晶拥有独特的属性，非常适合用来凝聚和集中激光束，同时也是制作大部分高级电子器材的关键材料。部分文化也视之为装饰物。
tooltips.en:
£rare_crystals£Rare Crystals
These crystals have properties that make them extremely effective at focusing laser beams, and they are also a critical component in most advanced electronics. In addition, many cultures treasure them as decorations and adornments.

tooltips.zh:
£exotic_gases£异星天然气
罕见的异星天然气拥有各种用途，主要是用来为高级能量武器和能量力场提供能源。部分也用作舰船燃料或消遣性毒品。
tooltips.en:
£exotic_gases£Exotic Gases
Rare and exotic gases with a variety of different uses, particularly in the operation of advanced energy-based weaponry and force fields. Some of the gases can also be used as starship fuel or even as recreational drugs.

tooltips.zh:
£volatile_motes£易爆微粒
这些超自然粒子蕴含有惊人的能量，可以被精炼为能源或者用作燃料和炸药。
tooltips.en:
£volatile_motes£Volatile Motes
These preternatural particles contain a tremendous amount of energy which could be exploited in energy production, as fuel or even as explosives.

tooltips.zh:
£sr_zro£泽珞
一种在异星粒子中存在的极其稀有的气溶胶，随着陨石撞击被一起发现。不过其真正的来源依然是个未解之谜。若拥有灵能天赋的[GetIndividualNamePlural]将泽珞[GetIngestedLoc]后，它会是一种能极大的提高灵能力量（并可能导致成瘾）的[GetDrugLoc]。
tooltips.en:
£sr_zro£Zro
An extremely rare aerosol of exotic particles. It has been deposited on a number of worlds through meteor impacts, but its true origin is a mystery. If [GetIngestedLoc] by psionically-gifted [GetIndividualNamePlural], zro acts as a very potent (and addictive) [GetDrugLoc] that enhances psionic abilities.

tooltips.zh:
£sr_dark_matter£暗物质
这种神秘物质具有许多似乎可以打破所谓自然法则的性质。该物质仅在黑洞周围或部分星云附近才能达到可供开采的浓度。
tooltips.en:
£sr_dark_matter£Dark Matter
This exotic substance has many properties that seemingly defy several natural laws. Harvestable concentrations can only be found near Black Holes or in certain nebulas.

tooltips.zh:
£sr_living_metal£活体金属
该无机金属有着通常生命体才具备的特征。会自动恢复到其被塑造好的形态。
tooltips.en:
£sr_living_metal£Living Metal
This inorganic metal shows characteristics usually seen only in biological life forms. It will always attempt to regenerate back into the shape it was stabilized into.

tooltips.zh:
£astral_threads£星界丝缕
£astral_threads£星界丝缕是一种时空浓缩而来的细丝，是不同维度位面互相碰撞的产物。可以用来产生各种全国范围的效果。
tooltips.en:
£astral_threads£Astral Threads
£astral_threads£ Astral Threads are filaments of condensed space-time: the result of dimensional planes colliding with one another. They can be spent to enact various empire-wide effects.
